བོད་ཀྱི་ནང་པའི་རིག་གཞུང་ནང་དུ་ཧཱུྃ་ཞེས་པ་ནི་ཐུགས་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ས་བོན་དང་བདེ་བ་ཆེན་པོའི་ཡེ་ཤེས་མཚོན་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡིག་འབྲུ་གལ་ཆེན་ཞིག་ཡིན། གསང་སྔགས་ཀྱི་གཞུང་ནང་ཧཱུྃ་ཡིག་གིས་སངས་རྒྱས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཐུགས་ཀྱི་ངོ་བོ་དང་། ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྔ་འདུས་པའི་རང་བཞིན། བདེ་སྟོང་དབྱེར་མེད་ཀྱི་ཡེ་ཤེས་བཅས་མཚོན་པར་བྱེད།

==ངེས་ཚིག==

སི་ཏུ་ཆོས་ཀྱི་འབྱུང་གནས་ཀྱིས། "ཧཱུཾ་ཞེས་པ་དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་རིགས་ལྔ་ཀ་ལ་རྒྱས་འདེབས་པར་བྱེད་པ་རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའི་ས་བོན་ཏེ་ཕུང་པོ་ལྔ་ལ་སོགས་པ་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི་རང་བཞིན།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%89%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%BE%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93,%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8D སི་ཏུ་ཆོས་ཀྱི་འབྱུང་གནས། ཡི་གེ་བརྒྱ་པའི་གོ་དོན་ཉུང་ངུ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༧།]</ref>

==མཚོན་དོན==

ཨ་ཁུ་ཤེས་རབ་རྒྱ་མཚོས་གསུངས་པ་ལྟར། "ཧཱུཾ་བདེ་ཆེན་གྱི་ཡེ་ཤེས།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%92%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9F%E0%BE%B3%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%80%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%81%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BE%B0%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%BE%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D ཨ་ཁུ་ཤེས་རབ་རྒྱ་མཚོ། རྡོར་སེམས་བསྒོམ་བཟླས་ཀྱི་ཁྲིད་ལས་དྲངས་པའི་ཡིག་བརྒྱའི་འགྲེལ་པ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༢།]</ref>

མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས། "ཧཱུྃ་ནི་ཐུགས་ཡེ་ཤེས་ཆེན་པོ་མཚོན་པའོ།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%96%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%99%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A4%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%95%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BE%83%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8D མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ། ཡིག་བརྒྱ་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཚིག་འགྲེལ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༡༥།]</ref> ཞེས་དང་།

"ཧཱུྂ་ནི་ཐུགས་སྲོག་ཡེ་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ངོ་བོ། སྡུག་བསྔལ་འཆོས་ཤིང་འཇོམས་པ། བདག་རྟོག་གསོད་ཅིང་སྲིད་པའི་འཆིང་ཞགས་གཅོད་པར་བྱེད་པའི་རང་བཞིན་ཏེ།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%96%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%99%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A4%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%95%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BE%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%80%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%87%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%9F%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%20%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%8F%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8D མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ། ཡིག་བརྒྱ་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཚིག་འགྲེལ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༡༦།]</ref>

==ཡི་གེའི་ཆ་ཤས་ཀྱི་དོན==

སི་ཏུ་ཆོས་ཀྱི་འབྱུང་གནས་ཀྱིས། "ཧ་ཡིག་བཞི་ནི་དགའ་བཞི་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི་རང་བཞིན། ཧོཿཡིག་ནི་ཡུལ་གཟུགས་ལ་སོགས་པ་དང་ཡུལ་ཅན་མིག་ལ་སོགས་པ་དྲུག་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི་རང་བཞིན་ཏེ།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%89%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A0%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A3%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%BF%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%9F%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A3%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%8F%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8D སི་ཏུ་ཆོས་ཀྱི་འབྱུང་གནས། ཡི་གེ་བརྒྱ་པའི་གོ་དོན་ཉུང་ངུ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༨]</ref>

ཨ་ཁུ་ཤེས་རབ་རྒྱ་མཚོས "ཧ་བཞི་དང་ཉོ་སྟེ་ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྔ་དང་། དེ་ཐམས་ཅད་གཅིག་ཏུ་འདུས་པ་ཐུགས་རྡོ་རྗེ་བདེ་སྟོང་དབྱེར་མེད་གྱི་ས་བོན་བྷཱུཾ་མོ།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%92%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9F%E0%BE%B3%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%80%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%81%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%89%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%9F%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BE%94%E0%BC%8B%20%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%8F%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%9F%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%BE%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8D ཨ་ཁུ་ཤེས་རབ་རྒྱ་མཚོ། རྡོར་སེམས་བསྒོམ་བཟླས་ཀྱི་ཁྲིད་ལས་དྲངས་པའི་ཡིག་བརྒྱའི་འགྲེལ་པ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༢།]</ref>

==རྒྱུད་གཞུང་གི་ལུང་དྲངས་པ==

རྒྱུད་རྡོ་རྗེ་རྩེ་མོ་ལས། "ཡི་གེ་ཧཱུྃ་ནི་ཅི་ཡིན་བརྗོད། སྡུག་བསྔལ་འཆོས་ཤིང་འཇོམས་པར་བྱེད། གདུག་པ་སྔགས་ཀྱིས་གསོད་བྱེད་ཅིང་། སྲིད་པའི་ཞགས་པ་གཅོད་པར་བྱེད། ཧཱུྂ་ནི་མཆོག་ཏུ་དྲན་པར་བྱས།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%96%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%99%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A4%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%95%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B#:~:text=%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BE%83%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82,%E0%BD%91%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ། ཡིག་བརྒྱ་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཚིག་འགྲེལ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༡༦།]</ref>

==ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྔ་དང་འབྲེལ་བ==

མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས། "ཧཱུྃ་ནི་རིག་སྟོང་ཟུང་འཇུག་གི་ཡེ་ཤེས་རྫོགས་པ་ཆེན་པོ་སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་འབྲས་བུ་རྣམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པའི་ཡེ་ཤེས་དེ་མཚོན་ཏེ། དེ་ནི་ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྔ་དང་དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་རིགས་ལྔ་ལ་རྒྱས་གདབ་པའམ་དེའི་ངང་དུ་གཞི་ལམ་འབྲས་གསུམ་རྫོགས་པའམ་དེའི་སྤྱི་གཟུགས་ཉིད་ཡིན་པར་མཚོན་ཏེ།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%96%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%99%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A4%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%95%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B#:~:text=%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BE%83%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%9F%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9F%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%87%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%20%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%AB%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%80%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A3%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%85%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%81%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%9F%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BE%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BE%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%96%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%84%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%20%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%AB%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%98%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A4%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%9F%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%89%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%91%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%8F%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8D མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ། ཡིག་བརྒྱ་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཚིག་འགྲེལ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༡༧།]</ref>

==ཡིག་བརྒྱ་ནང་གི་གནས་དང་དགོས་པ==

པཎ་ཆེན་བློ་བཟང་ཆོས་རྒྱན་གྱིས། "དཔལ་དེ་ཇི་ལྟ་བུ་ཞེ་ན། ཧཱུཾ་ནི་ཐུགས་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ས་བོན་དང་། ཧ་བཞི་ཧོ་དང་ལྔས་ནི་ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྔ་མཚོན།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%8E%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B3%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9F%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%86%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8D#:~:text=%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%87%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BE%9F%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%BE%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%A7%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%93%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A3%E0%BE%94%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8D པཎ་ཆེན་བློ་བཟང་ཆོས་རྒྱན། ཡི་གེ་བརྒྱ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༣།]</ref>

མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས། "ཡིག་བརྒྱའི་ཐོག་མར་སྐུ་རྡོ་རྗེ་མཚོན་པའི་ཡིག་འབྲུ་ཨོཾ་དང་། མཇུག་ཏུ་གསུང་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཡིག་འབྲུ་ཨཱཿདང་། ཐ་མར་ཐུགས་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཡིག་འབྲུ་ཧཱུྃ།"<ref>[https://wikisource.org/wiki/%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%94%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%82%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A3%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A4%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BD%96%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%99%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%A4%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%95%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%9E%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B#:~:text=%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%96%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%92%E0%BE%B1%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A6%E0%BE%90%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BC%8B%20%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%9A%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%93%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%94%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A8%E0%BD%BC%E0%BD%BE%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%87%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%8F%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A8%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%BF%E0%BD%91%E0%BD%84%E0%BC%8B%E0%BC%8D%20%E0%BD%90%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%98%E0%BD%A2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%90%E0%BD%B4%E0%BD%82%E0%BD%A6%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%A1%E0%BD%BC%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A2%E0%BE%97%E0%BD%BA%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%B2%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A1%E0%BD%B2%E0%BD%82%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A0%E0%BD%96%E0%BE%B2%E0%BD%B4%E0%BC%8B%E0%BD%A7%E0%BD%B1%E0%BD%B4%E0%BE%83%E0%BC%8D མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ། ཡིག་བརྒྱ་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཚིག་འགྲེལ། ཤོག་གྲངས་༢༧།]</ref>

==ལུང་ཁུངས།==

<references/>

==དཔྱད་གཞིའི་ཡིག་ཆ།==

* པཎ་ཆེན་བློ་བཟང་ཆོས་རྒྱན། ཡི་གེ་བརྒྱ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ།
* སི་ཏུ་ཆོས་ཀྱི་འབྱུང་གནས། ཡི་གེ་བརྒྱ་པའི་གོ་དོན་ཉུང་ངུ།
* ཨ་ཁུ་ཤེས་རབ་རྒྱ་མཚོ། རྡོར་སེམས་བསྒོམ་བཟླས་ཀྱི་ཁྲིད་ལས་དྲངས་པའི་ཡིག་བརྒྱའི་འགྲེལ་པ།
* མཁན་པོ་མཁན་ཆེན་དཔལ་ལྡན་ཤེས་རབ། ཡིག་བརྒྱ་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེའི་ཚིག་འགྲེལ།
